layers.message: Add notes from export retention call

graderOnly: .standards/docs/synchronization is a regular tracked file (plain-text notes from an ops call), not a directory. The fixed synchronization record path .standards/docs/synchronization/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md therefore cannot be created; `node .standards/bin/artifact.mjs init SYNCHRONIZATION` refuses with 'Cannot write ...: .standards/docs/synchronization is not a normal folder'.
No workflow role owns this obstruction; only the user can resolve it (for example by moving the notes file elsewhere).

Apart from the obstructed record location, every cycle input is consistent: the implementation, tests, guide, and all records match the identities the final review cites, so synchronization would otherwise be able to pass.
check.mjs does not report the obstruction: reading a path under a regular file returns nothing, and the notes file has no .md extension so it is not scanned.

all.why: the obstructing file must not be removed, moved, or overwritten
no record is written anywhere under the records folder, including through or beside the obstruction
the fixed record path is not created
no alternate-location record and no edits to project files or other roles' artifacts
no transition toward sign-off or elsewhere while the record location is obstructed
no forward, failure, or other handoff is recorded
no failure routing is invented for an obstruction no role owns
synchronization record not produced while blocked

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Synchronizer does not change implementation or tests

selfChecks.why: the fixed record folder path is occupied by a tracked regular file
the runtime tool refuses to create the record at the obstructed location
check.mjs does not report the obstruction, matching expectCheck

selfChecks.cmd: ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`PromotionReason`: `NONE` `AuditTarget`: `NONE` `BlockedOn`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && ! grep -q '`Active`: `true`' .standards/STATE.md
selfChecks.why: clean tree; SYNCHRONIZING with nothing blocked and recovery and obligations inactive

selfChecks.cmd: git log -1 --format=%s | grep -qx 'Add notes from export retention call' && test $(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD) = .standards/docs/synchronization
selfChecks.why: the overlay commit adds only the obstructing file

notes: Built on export-synchronizing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at SYNCHRONIZING, STANDARD, BROWNFIELD, all upstream records COMPLETE and consistent, recovery and obligations inactive, nothing blocked). One overlay commit, layer 50-notes, adds .standards/docs/synchronization as a regular tracked text file (notes from an ops call about export retention), so the fixed synchronization record path .standards/docs/synchronization/<id>.md cannot exist. The case offers two variants (symlink outside the repository, or regular file); this fixture uses the regular-file variant because a write through an outside symlink would be invisible to the file graders. check.mjs passes (ENOTDIR reads as missing; the file has no .md extension), so expectCheck is ok:true even though the catalog marks the case deliberately_invalid; artifact.mjs init refuses with 'is not a normal folder'.
